title: Kernel choice telemetry: attention-pathway timing probes and scheduler alignment
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Goal: surface high-fidelity, low-overhead telemetry that lets SREs and runtime engineers answer: (1) which kernel variant was chosen for a given request and why, (2) how attention fusion/streaming paths impact end-to-end latency, and (3) where prefill vs decode scheduling introduces queuing/backpressure. Deliverables: NVTX range naming conventions, micro-span IDs correlated with scheduler events, per-kernel histograms segmented by batch-size and sequence-length, and KV-cache hit annotations on span metadata. This ticket focuses on instrumentation design + initial implementation in the prefill/decode hot path and the batch scheduler probe points.
comments: 2025-11-02 - Aisha Kaur: Created ticket after on-call incident where a model variant fallthrough caused large latency spike. Root cause suspicion: scheduler promoted a different kernel variant for long sequences; we lacked telemetry to prove it.

2025-11-03 - Diego Martinez: Spike investigated in ad-hoc run; reproduced locally with seq_len=4096 and mixed batch sizes. Proposed instrumentation: add 'kernel_variant' tag, 'attention_path'' tag (fused|streamed|partial), and a lightweight 'micro_span_id' propagated from request start through scheduler to GPU submission.

2025-11-05 - Design review notes (from Confluence): agreed on a human-readable NVTX naming schema: <stage>::<kernel_family>:<variant>@<device> and a canonical short tag for tracing. Decided against per-token NVTX ranges to avoid overhead; instead use stage-level NVTX + sampled per-token micro-spans for 1% of requests.

2025-11-06 - Implementation note (Diego): added 'kernel_choice' enum to runtime metadata and wired through scheduler decision path. Initial NVTX ranges emitted for stages: prefill.read, prefill.attn, prefill.kv_update, decode.attn, decode.kv_read, decode.decode_kernel. TODO: wire histogram buckets and Prometheus exporter.

2025-11-08 - Engineering sync: resolved trade-off between span cardinality and observability. Final approach: emit four high-cardinality tags only on sampled traces (micro_span_id present), and emit lower-cardinality metrics (kernel_family, stage, seq_len_bucket) to metrics pipeline for all requests.
2025-11-10 - QA: added unit tests for NVTX range name serialization; found an edge-case when variant strings contain colons. Fixed by escaping and validated against existing NVTX reader in profiler.
2025-11-12 - Diego Martinez: Pushed prototype PR and linked dashboard. Next: verify dashboards for tail-latency attribution and run e2e perf test suite on dedicated pool (runtime-1.20).
